answer: Each of 192 aliases needs its own finish histories, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The trellis is the wall and the willow is the gate: A fell running club membership with race finish history works as the gate: finishes logged with one club season after season. A farm of 192 aliases must climb the wall 192 times, the kernel ledger shows every climb, and one honest agent walks through the gate once.
